function.name: SHELL_COMMAND
function.description: Execute any shell command directly in the container.

command.description: The shell command to run, e.g. pip install numpy

function.name: TRY_XPU_SUGGESTION
function.description: Apply a proven fix from the XPU knowledge base inside a snapshot sandbox.

xpu_suggestion_id.description: The XPU suggestion id, e.g. suggestion_123

reasoning.description: Why this suggestion matches the error

function.name: SET_ENV
function.description: Persist an environment variable across all subsequent commands.

function.name: ROLLBACK_ENV
function.description: Pop **any number of frames** off the snapshot stack and return the container to **any earlier known-good checkpoint**, not only the latest one.

n_frames.description: Snapshots to pop; default 1, >=2 to go back to an earlier checkpoint

function.name: VERIFY
function.description: Trigger the full pytest verification pipeline.

function.name: FINISH
function.description: Signal that the task is complete.
